operators.name: hardshrink_forward
semantics: Computes Hardshrink with lambda=0.5 elementwise: y = x if abs(x) > 0.5 else 0.
Preserves input strides, shape, and dtype for float32 CUDA tensors.
Does not modify input; returns a newly allocated contiguous tensor with same shape and stride as input (contiguous output).
Applies Hardshrink activation with threshold 0.5: output[i] = input[i] if |input[i]| > 0.5 else 0.
Input is a CUDA float32 tensor of shape [16, 3, 4096, 4096] with contiguous strides [50331648, 16777216, 4096, 1].
Output is a CUDA float32 tensor with the same shape, strides, and dtype as input.
